description: This file defines a class 'LessThanOrEqual' which implements a validation rule to determine if an input value is less than or equal to a specified target object. The class extends an abstract rule and supports validation against DateTime, float, int, or callable target objects.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqual
classes.description: Validation rule class that checks if an input value is less than or equal to a target object, supporting DateTime and other comparable types.

methods.name: __construct
